Name: Bounty on Murlocs
Evidence: Seen on the WoW: Forever beta on 11 October 2026 by the user's level 16 to 17 Night Elf rogue, who hadn't done Deliver Thomas' Report (39): the map showed three quests at Guard Thomas (261), but he offered only Report to Gryan Stoutmantle (109) and Protect the Frontier (52), not Bounty on Murlocs. A Wowhead Classic comment of June 2020 (rated +19) says Guard Thomas doesn't offer Bounty on Murlocs until his report has been delivered to Marshal Dughan, which is quest 39. QuestieDB's Era and Forever corrections (classicQuestFixes.lua) both give 46 the previous quest 39. CMaNGOS z2815 has no previous quest, group or condition on 46. Not yet tried after handing in 39.

Name: Snatch and Grab
Evidence: Tried on the WoW: Forever beta (build 1.60.1.70338) on 11 October 2026 with the user's level 16 Night Elf rogue: after The Apple Falls (2241) and Destiny Calls (2242), Keryn Sylvius (917) still offered Seek out SI: 7, and Master Mathias Shaw (332) offered Snatch and Grab only once Seek out SI: 7 was handed in. So Seek out SI: 7 is required, not a breadcrumb to skip, and another city's lead-in doesn't do. Questie issue #1466 (Classic, November 2019): a player who did all three cities' chains says each needs its own lead-in. A Thottbot comment of 27 October 2005 on Wowhead answers why Snatch and Grab can't be started: talk to Keryn Sylvius first. CMaNGOS has Seek out SI: 7 only as Snatch and Grab's breadcrumb (BreadcrumbForQuestId), with no previous quest; the breadcrumb stays. Found by the user on 11 October 2026.

Name: Destiny Calls
Evidence: Questie issue #1466 (Classic, November 2019): a player who did all three cities' chains says each needs its own lead-in, The Apple Falls for Destiny Calls. A Wowhead comment of 27 March 2007 on The Apple Falls says Destiny Calls was offered once it was handed in. The same as Snatch and Grab (2206) and Seek out SI: 7, tried on the WoW: Forever beta on 11 October 2026; not yet tried on Forever for this quest. Wowhead Classic lists any of the three lead-ins as enough, which the test of Snatch and Grab contradicts. CMaNGOS has The Apple Falls only as Destiny Calls's breadcrumb (BreadcrumbForQuestId), with no previous quest; the breadcrumb stays.

Name: Seek out SI: 7
Evidence: CMaNGOS puts the three cities' level 10 rogue lead-ins, Seek out SI: 7 (2205, Stormwind), Road to Salvation (2218, Ironforge) and The Apple Falls (2241, Darnassus), in one ExclusiveGroup, so the addon ticked the other two when one was handed in, and at every login. On the WoW: Forever beta (build 1.60.1.70338) on 11 October 2026, the user's level 16 Night Elf rogue, who had done The Apple Falls and Destiny Calls (2242), was still offered Seek out SI: 7 by Keryn Sylvius (917) and handed it in. Questie issue #1466 (Classic, November 2019): one player did all three cities' chains, and their IsQuestFlaggedCompleted showed all three lead-ins done. A Wowhead comment of 27 June 2025 on The Apple Falls says to do all three lead-ins first. The only limit is the chains' unique reward, Blade of Cunning, sold before each later hand-in.
